summary: Mrs. Bensadon examines the laws and procedure of the Sotah in Parashat Nasso. She compares the use of water and dust in the Sotah process to Chet HaEgl and the flood of Noach. She also discusses why these laws are recorded in Sefer Bamidbar instead of Sefer Vayikra and how human relationships relate to one's relationship with Hashem.
questions: Why is the topic of Sotah written in Sefer Bamidbar instead of Sefer Vayikra?
Why is the name of Hashem allowed to be erased during the Sotah procedure?
How does the Sotah process compare to the events of Chet HaEgl?
Why is the Sotah procedure a voluntary process for the couple?
